title: airgap: add apt/yum repo metadata + slim runtime bundles for offline installs
author: Ava Chen
commits: a1f4b2a: airgap: add generator for apt/yum repo metadata and Packages/repodata index
c9e7d11: packaging: produce slim runtime images (alpine-based) for init and probe containers
b3d0fae: installer: wire new bundle manifest format and repo-mapper in bundle extractor
e5f6c22: docs: airgap.md - offline repo setup instructions and GPG key rotation section
f9a2b88: tests: add integration test that validates apt repo served from local http and yum metadata correctness
description: Motivation: customers running on-prem/private installs often hit two pain points: (1) large monolithic tarballs that waste bandwidth and storage when only runtime artifacts are needed; (2) lack of standard apt/yum metadata in bundles makes tooling brittle for distributions that expect repo indices. This PR introduces a new bundle layout and tooling to reduce airgap bundle size, support OS package repositories out-of-the-box, and improve reproducible installs. Summary of changes: add airgap repo metadata generator that creates Packages.gz and repodata/repomd.xml for deb/rpm artifacts; add lightweight 'slim' runtime images for init, health-probe and migrator containers (alpine-based with static-linked helpers) and a build pipeline that outputs both full and slim images into the bundle; introduce an 'airgap-manifest.json' (minimal, stable schema v1) that lists package names, shasums, signed-gpg key IDs, and repository indexes for apt/yum + image index for containerd/CRI; update the bundle extractor to optionally populate a local apt/yum HTTP server (repo-proxy) used during install so machines can apt-get/yum install from the local repository without internet access; add helper script to import and rotate GPG keys used for repository verification; update helm chart packaging step to produce a helm-index.yaml inside the bundle and add a small init hook that can serve the chart archive to helm client during install; add integration tests that spawn a temporary HTTP server to validate apt/yum indices and verify package installation in a minimal Ubuntu 20.04 and Rocky Linux 8 chroot; docs updated with step-by-step airgap preparation, size expectations and migration notes. Checklist: - [x] generator for apt/yum metadata - [x] slim runtime images and packaging pipeline - [x] bundle manifest and extractor changes - [x] local repo-proxy implementation and tests - [x] GPG import/rotation helpers - [x] docs and upgrade notes Backwards compatibility: bundle extractor maintains support for the old flat tar layout; new manifest is optional and extractor will fall back if not present. Upgrade strategy: bundles produced by the new pipeline will be backward-compatible to older installers; however, to fully leverage slim images and repo indices, customers should upgrade the installer to >= the release that includes this PR. Related: hits SUP-3124 for on-prem support requests.
release_notes: Add optional airgap bundle manifest + apt/yum indices, introduce slim runtime images to reduce offline bundle size, and local repo-proxy to serve OS packages during install. Backward-compatible extractor fallback when manifest absent.
review_comments: Marcus Li: Requested that Packages.gz generation include debian-arch and component fields to play nicely with apt-mirror; also asked for deterministic ordering of files to improve reproducible shasums.
Ava Chen: Implemented deterministic sort and added component/arch metadata; updated tests to assert exact repodata hashes.
Diego Ramos: Asked for clear guidance on GPG key rotation and to surface errors during import rather than silently proceed. Left a suggestion for retry/backoff in networked imports.
Ava Chen: Added import checks, explicit exit codes and retry with exponential backoff in import_gpg_key.sh; documented behavior in airgap.md.
Priya Nair: Noted that slim images must pass security scan; requested that packaging pipeline push slim images to a staging registry in CI so scans can run. CI job was added and scans pass.
QA Team: Ran integration tests against Ubuntu20.04 and Rocky8 in ephemeral chroots; found one edge case for locales which was fixed by adding locale data to slim images.
merge_commit: squash-merge: add airgap repo metadata and slim images (PR 26111)
notes_for_ops: When generating bundles for customers: use --slim to produce both full and slim variants; include signed manifest with --gpg-key-id; recommended GPG key TTL is 2y and rotation process is documented in docs/airgap.md. Monitor repo-proxy logs (installer/extractor/repo_proxy.log) for 401/403 during package fetches in initial installs.
changelog: airgap: smaller offline bundles via slim runtime images; apt/yum repo indices included so offline installs can use native package managers; stable manifest v1 for bundle metadata; local repo-proxy for zero-internet installs.
